load_nba_tutorial_data: run load_data to extract, transform, and load NBA foul call data from GitHub into a pandas DataFrame
extract_nba_data: create an ExtractNBATutorialData instance to fetch raw NBA game CSV data from a remote GitHub URL
transform_nba_data: build a TransformNBATutorialData pipeline to clean, filter, and encode NBA foul call records for analysis
plot_foul_types: create a vertical bar plot showing the count of each foul type using Bokeh with a log scale
plot_trailing_team_committing: build a line plot comparing foul call rates when the committing team is trailing versus not trailing
